title: problem.get
description: Retrieve unresolved problems (and, if requested, recently resolved ones) according to the given parameters.

eventids.description: Return only problems with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only problems created by objects that belong to the given host groups.

hostids.description: Return only problems created by objects that belong to the given hosts.

objectids.description: Return only problems created by the given objects.

source.description: Return only problems with the given type. Refer to the problem event object page for a list of supported event types. Possible values: 0 - event created by a trigger; 3 - internal event; 4 - event created on service status update. Default: 0 - problem created by a trigger.

object.description: Return only problems created by objects of the given type. Refer to the problem event object page for a list of supported object types. Possible values if source is set to "event created by a trigger": 0 - trigger. Possible values if source is set to "internal event": 0 - trigger; 4 - item; 5 - LLD rule. Possible values if source is set to "event created on service status update": 6 - service. Default: 0 - trigger.

acknowledged.description: If set to true return only acknowledged problems.

action.description: Return only problems for which the given event update actions have been performed. For multiple actions, use a sum of any acceptable bitmap values as bitmask (for example, 34 for acknowledge and suppress event). Possible bitmap values (see event.acknowledge): 1 - close problem; 4 - add message; 6 - acknowledge event; 8 - change severity; 16 - unacknowledge event; 32 - suppress event; 64 - unsuppress event; 128 - change event rank to cause; 256 - change event rank to symptom.

action_userids.description: Return only problems with the given IDs of users who performed the problem event update actions.

suppressed.description: If set to true return only suppressed problems.

symptom.description: If set to true return only symptom problem events.

severities.description: Return only problems with given event severities. Applies only if object is trigger. Possible values: 0 - not classified; 1 - information; 2 - warning; 3 - average; 4 - high; 5 - disaster.

evaltype.description: Tag evaluation method. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

tags.description: Return only problems with the given tags. Format: [{"tag": "<tag>", "value": "<value>", "operator": "<operator>"}, ...]. An empty array returns all problems.

operator.description: Possible values: 0 - (default) Contains; 1 - Equals; 2 - Does not contain; 3 - Does not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Does not exist.

recent.description: If set to true, return recent problems, including those resolved within the ok_period and any unresolved problems. If set to false, return only unresolved problems.

eventid_from.description: Return only problems with IDs greater or equal to the given ID.

eventid_till.description: Return only problems with IDs less or equal to the given ID.

time_from.description: Return only problems that have been created after or at the given time.

time_till.description: Return only problems that have been created before or at the given time.

selectAcknowledges.description: Return an acknowledges property with the problem updates. Problem updates are sorted in reverse chronological order. The problem update object has the following properties: acknowledgeid - (ID) ID of the update; userid - (ID) ID of the user that updated the event; eventid - (ID) ID of the updated event; clock - (timestamp) time when the event was updated; message - (string) text of the message; action - (integer) type of update action (see event.acknowledge); old_severity - (integer) event severity before this update action; new_severity - (integer) event severity after this update action; suppress_until - (timestamp) time till event will be suppressed; taskid - (ID) ID of the task if the current event is undergoing a rank change. Supports count.

selectTags.description: Return a tags property with the problem tags. Output format: [{"tag": "<tag>", "value": "<value>"}, ...].

selectSuppressionData.description: Return a suppression_data property with the list of active maintenances and manual suppressions: maintenanceid - (ID) ID of the maintenance; userid - (ID) ID of user who suppressed the problem; suppress_until - (integer) time until the problem is suppressed.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Does not support properties of text data type.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values: eventid.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
